pages: WELCOME TO WYZE Welcome to the Wyze family! Great choice picking up the Wyze Thermostat - it’s one of our favorite products in the Wyze lineup. Whether you’re looking to adjust the temperature while staying tucked into bed or warm up the house on your way home from work you can now get it all done from the Wyze app. We’re excited for you to start enjoying it!
